parsed.summary: Router r3 connects the DMZ and sensors segments to the client-side networks via a link to r2. It acts as a gateway for client segments (10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.99.0/24) through the eth1 interface. It also provides direct access to the DMZ and sensors segments via eth2 and eth3 interfaces.

interfaces.name: eth1
interfaces.role: gateway for client-side segments via link to r2

static_routes.purpose: routes traffic from the client segment 10.0.1.0/24 through eth1 to r2
routes traffic from the client segment 10.0.2.0/24 through eth1 to r2
routes traffic from the client segment 10.0.99.0/24 through eth1 to r2
